name: No. 10: Full Confidence
storyline: You're the Prime Minister. It's going about as well as you'd expect. No. 10: Full Confidence is a darkly comic political survival game where you cling to power through an endless parade of very British crises; strikes, scandals, a Chancellor who's done something unspeakable, and newspapers sharpening their knives before breakfast. Every crisis lands on your desk with a ticking clock and no good options: please the Cabinet and enrage the backbenchers, throw the Media a bone and watch the Public turn, or make the brave choice and lose everyone at once. Keep the four factions of Cabinet, Backbenchers, Media and Public, just onside enough to survive another month in office. Lose them, and you'll be remembered in the way British Prime Ministers usually are: briefly, and unkindly. Hundreds of hand-written crises, a cast of rivals with their own designs on your job, and a fresh way to fall from grace every single time. It's the impossible job, as a game. How long can you last?
summary: No. 10: Full Confidence is a political satire survival game, with you as British PM. Open your red ministerial box, decide which ridiculous crisis to fix, and keep Cabinet, Backbenchers, the Media, and the Public just barely on side.
